page.content:
Empathy machine that blade runners use as a test.

How Voight-Kampff connects

  • Faction: Blade Runners — Blade runners use the Voight-Kampff test to identify replicants.
  • Character: Rick Deckard — Deckard administers the Voight-Kampff to Rachael.

What is Voight-Kampff?

The Voight-Kampff machine watches the eye for empathic response, the official way 2019 tells a human from a replicant — and the test Rachael nearly beats.

Key threads lead to Blade Runners and Rick Deckard.
